tier1.text: The telencephalon becomes the cerebrum, the part of the brain in charge of memory, emotion and consciousness. Of all the parts of the brain, the cerebrum is the largest. A large gap splits the cerebrum into right and left halves, called cerebral hemispheres. As the telencephalon grows inside the skull, the brain forms folds that look alike in everyone.

quotes.quote: There is a large separation between the two sides of the cerebrum called the longitudinal fissure. It separates the cerebrum into two distinct halves, a right and left cerebral hemisphere.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

quotes.quote: During embryonic development, as the telencephalon expands within the skull, the brain goes through a regular course of growth that results in everyone’s brain having a similar pattern of folds.
